player_prompt.intro:
Uyithathei {role} eColonel Blotto.
Inhloso yakho iyakuba ngaphezulu kwabaphambili bakho.
Kwa yilapho ngalinye, alota ngamabutho angaphezulu kwamabutho {num_total_units} ngaphezulu kwezifiso {field_names}.
Uthathei othatheka ngamabutho amaningi kuzifiso, uyathatha lezo zifiso, nothathei othatheka izifiso ezingaphezulu, uyathatha iraundu.
Njengombono, '[A7 B7 C6]' inotha 7 ngamabutho kwa-A, 7 kwa-B, na 6 kwa-C.
